items.title: Send these readings to your care team today
items.text: You should contact your care team today because 6.3% of your readings were above 250 mg/dL. Your average was 176.9 mg/dL, and the usual target is under 5%.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after 1 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: You didn't have any scored dinners that started at 8 pm or later, which is good. Having late dinners is linked to sugar rising about 9.2 mg/dL more.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You averaged 14.5 hours of overnight fasting, with 100.0% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding overnight fasting to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
